New Mercedes GLC Electric Launch Price Rs 78.50 Lakh

KS
By Kabir Sharma Indian Automotive & SUV Specialist • via Rushlane.com Wire
⚡ Visual Story
Source & Photography: Rushlane.com Wire Dispatch Verified Editorial Asset
⚡ Executive Takeaways & Key Highlights
  • First unveiled in Sep 2025 , the new GLC EV has finally arrived in India.
  • Mercedes-Benz India has launched the Electric GLC 400 4MATIC at Rs 78.50 lakh, ex-showroom, alongside the commencement of local assembly at its Chakan facility near Pune.
  • The first locally assembled example has rolled off the line, with customer deliveries scheduled to begin in mid-November 2026.
⚡ EDITORIAL TAKE • KABIR SHARMA Indian Automotive & SUV Specialist

Bharat NCAP Safety Standards & Indian Road Readiness

In India's rapidly evolving automotive landscape, crashworthiness and real-world durability are driving consumer purchase decisions like never before. As reported by Rushlane.com, indigenous automakers like Tata Motors and Mahindra are setting global safety benchmarks while optimizing suspension and ground clearance for unpredictable road conditions.

Big Picture: Upcoming monthly FADA retail delivery reports and Bharat NCAP rating scorecards will reveal which domestic models capture mass-market dominance.

First unveiled in Sep 2025 , the new GLC EV has finally arrived in India. Mercedes-Benz India has launched the Electric GLC 400 4MATIC at Rs 78.50 lakh, ex-showroom, alongside the commencement of local assembly at its Chakan facility near Pune. The first locally assembled example has rolled off the line, with customer deliveries scheduled to begin in mid-November 2026.

📌 The Core Development

The GLC 400 4MATIC uses a dual-motor all-wheel-drive powertrain producing 360 kW and 800 Nm. Mercedes claims a 0–100 km/h acceleration time of 4.3 seconds, giving the SUV a strong performance brief alongside its luxury positioning. A 94 kWh battery delivers a claimed WLTP range of up to 711 km.

The SUV also introduces 800-volt electrical architecture, supporting DC fast charging at up to 330 kW. Under optimal conditions, Mercedes says it can add up to 303 km of range in 10 minutes. Achieving that figure will depend on charger capability, battery temperature and state of charge.

🔍 Background & Sector Context

The Electric GLC brings a substantial technology upgrade, led by a 39.1-inch MBUX Hyperscreen. It runs the Mercedes-Benz Operating System, or MB.OS, supporting connected functions, intelligent navigation, driver assistance, over-the-air updates and personalised user experiences.

Exterior highlights include an illuminated grille incorporating 942 pixels. Inside, the SKY CONTROL panoramic roof with illuminated stars adds another distinctive feature to the cabin. Mercedes also highlights the use of recycled materials and materials with a reduced carbon footprint as part of the SUV’s development.

📊 Industry & Real-World Impact

At Chakan, the Electric GLC is assembled on the same flexible line as Mercedes-Benz’s combustion-engine models. This allows the facility to handle multiple vehicle platforms and both electric and combustion powertrains under one roof.

🔮 Strategic Outlook & What Lies Ahead

Mercedes-Benz India has committed an additional Rs 200 crore in 2026 towards manufacturing operations, new-model preparation and digitisation. This takes its cumulative investment in India to Rs 3,200 crore.

The company says the facility runs more than 15 live AI projects, supporting quality monitoring, operational efficiency, supply-chain planning and workforce development. Camera-based inspection systems are among the tools used to monitor quality.
